messages:
mira.design: Quick heads-up from a keyboard + SR pass on the Models table. Found a few flaky behaviors with virtualization + actions. Short repros below.
kevin.frontend: thanks — can you paste steps? I can take the fixes for tabindex/focus.
lee.a11y: high-level: keep DOM focus in sync with visual selection, make per-row action buttons reliably tabbable even when virtualized, avoid duplicate header announcements in screen readers, and improve pill contrast.
mira.design: 1) Arrow-key row nav visually highlights the new row but DOM focus remains on the previously focused element. Keyboard users lose the focus ring when using j/k or arrow keys.
  repro: open Console > Models, press Down Arrow twice; observe highlight moves but no browser focus on new row.
  suggestion: call element.focus() when selection changes and use :focus-visible styles for keyboard-only rings.
kevin.frontend: yup we were only toggling aria-selected. I'll change the list controller to focus the newly selected row and add `:focus-visible` CSS rules.
lee.a11y: good. prefer focus-visible so mouse clicks don't show the ring. Also ensure focusable element is something semantic (button/link) or set tabindex=0 on the row.
mira.design: 2) Kebab action button (More) is not reliably reachable via Tab for virtual rows. Tab order jumps past it until I interact with the row.
  repro: Tab through page; many kebabs for offscreen(virtualized) rows are not in tab sequence until the row is expanded/interacted with.
  suggestion: keep interactive controls in DOM with tabindex=0 even when using virtualization; if duplicates used for render optimization, mark visual-only clones with aria-hidden="true" but keep the real control tabbable.
kevin.frontend: virtualization is the tricky part. I can ensure the action button is always rendered as a tabbable element and toggle its aria-hidden/visually-hidden state, so Tab will land on it predictably.
tara.qa: I'll add an end-to-end that tabs across 12 rows and asserts each row's kebab receives focus in order.
mira.design: 3) Screen readers (VoiceOver/NVDA) announce the column header twice when focusing a row cell. Example: "Model name, Models, row 4 of 8, Model name" — duplicate label.
  repro: VO on mac and NVDA on Windows both repeat the header for the first cell in the row.
  likely cause: aria-labelledby on the cell pointing at a heading plus the use of role="grid" and an explicit <th> — double referencing.
lee.a11y: check for aria-labelledby chains. We accidentally set aria-labelledby to include the column header and also left the native table header relationship intact. Fix: remove redundant aria-labelledby on the cell; use aria-describedby only when describing additional info.
kevin.frontend: I'll audit the row renderer to remove extra labelledby attributes and ensure cells use role="gridcell" properly. Also will run NVDA/VO after changes.
mira.design: 4) Status pills (e.g., experimental/deprecated) fall short on contrast at smaller sizes. Current tokens produce ~2.7:1 which is low.
  suggestion: switch pill text to a darker token or increase weight. Target WCAG 4.5:1 for normal text or at least 3:1 if bold/large.
kevin.frontend: will propose new semantic tokens: --status-pill-text and --status-pill-bg and push a tiny PR showing before/after.
tara.qa: adding visual regression check for pill color combos.
lee.a11y: small copy/accessibility nit: the kebab button label is simply "More" which lacks context for screen reader users. Use aria-label like "More actions for <model name>" so each control reads uniquely.
kevin.frontend: agreed, I'll set aria-label dynamically: `aria-label={`More actions for ${model.name}`}`.
mira.design: thanks — can we aim to land the focus + kebab tabbability fixes this sprint? they block keyboard workflows.
kevin.frontend: yep. I will split into two PRs: (A) focus sync + kebab tabbability (P0) due in 3 business days, (B) pill tokens + SR attribute cleanups (P1) next week.
lee.a11y: ping me on PR A for quick review; I'll also add a short checklist to the component README: "move DOM focus on arrow nav", "action buttons must be tabbable under virtualization", "no duplicated labelledby on cells", "pills meet contrast targets".
tara.qa: I'll prepare tests for both keyboard tab order and VO announcements.
mira.design: attaching screenshots and a small token proposal in the next message. thanks team! :sparkles:
